selection: Unchanged upstream BoT-SORT appearance/proximity settings; no tuning on the reviewed pairs. All comparisons reported.
scope: Post-review regression using the same frozen detections. Unchanged baseline track partitions were reproduced frame by frame.
limitations: Sparse correlated assistant references, not independent human ground truth or full-clip HOTA/IDF1. A missing endpoint is not a correct rejection. Generic pedestrian embeddings do not assign jersey identity or full-game statistics.
